name: Ubuntu Dotfiles
description: Installs zsh, oh-my-zsh, tmux, an optional coding agent (Claude Code or Codex) and personal dotfiles configuration. Each part can be turned off.

agent.description: Coding agent to install and configure.

installZsh.description: Install zsh and oh-my-zsh, make zsh the default shell and install .zshrc.

cloneRepo.description: Clone ubuntu-dotfiles to ~/ubuntu-dotfiles and add it to the VS Code workspace.
